definition.contrast: median over the AIMED box of |Lc - Lg| / (Lc + Lg)
definition.ground: median luma of ground_l and ground_r from the still's aim.json (the left and right tenth over the box's rows)
definition.height_m: median over the columns within 0.05 of the frame width of far_edge of the mask rows ABOVE far_edge, / px_per_m
definition.luma: Rec.709 on 0-1, CaptureRig's scale (0.2126 R + 0.7152 G + 0.0722 B, bytes / 255)
definition.mask: box pixels with contrast >= 0.12 against the ground median
definition.note: no min of gas and smoke: every still keeps its own numbers and its own bar
definition.rim: Michelson of the mask's top 6 rows per column against the mask's middle rows

contrast.why: a floor: the cloud may not read worse than the build before it

height_m.why: outside the spread of three captures of the current build (max + spread + 0.02)

rim.why: outside the spread of three captures of the current build (max + spread + 0.02)
